name: Circumscribed Choroidal Hemangioma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Imaging Diagnostic Criteria for Circumscribed Choroidal Hemangioma

criteria.description: Presence of an orange-red, well-circumscribed choroidal mass on fundoscopic examination
High internal reflectivity and acoustic solidity on B-scan ultrasonography
Early hyperfluorescence with late staining on fluorescein angiography
Early intense hyperfluorescence with rapid washout on indocyanine green angiography

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic clinical appearance plus supportive imaging findings on ultrasonography
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by multimodal imaging; biopsy is rarely required.

searchTerms: orange-red round mass in eye choroid

pathognomonic.symptomName: Serous retinal detachment overlying the lesion
pathognomonic.notes: Due to exudation from tumor vessels
searchTerms: fluid buildup under retina over lesion

common.notes: Often related to retinal detachment or macular involvement

searchTerms: loss of part of visual field

common.notes: Secondary to tumor or associated complications

occasional.notes: Visual distortion due to retinal involvement

rare.notes: Due to tumor-induced angle closure or neovascularization
Secondary to ischemia or tumor effects
searchTerms: new abnormal blood vessels in iris
growth of new blood vessels in eye iris

imaging: B-scan ultrasonography showing high internal reflectivity and acoustic solidity
Fluorescein angiography with early hyperfluorescence and late staining
Indocyanine green angiography demonstrating early intense hyperfluorescence with rapid washout
Optical coherence tomography showing subretinal fluid and retinal detachment
other: Fundoscopic examination revealing orange-red, well-circumscribed choroidal mass

distinguishingFeatures: Typically gray to brown lesion rather than orange-red
Low to medium internal reflectivity on ultrasonography
Presence of subretinal fluid but different angiographic patterns
Variable coloration, often creamy or yellowish

redFlags: New onset of severe visual loss
references: Shields CL, Shields JA. Circumscribed choroidal hemangioma: clinical features and management. Ophthalmology. 2001.
Daruich A, Matet A, Leveque C, et al. Circumscribed choroidal hemangioma: diagnosis and treatment. Int J Retina Vitreous. 2017.
